description: Dock at a station in your sector; needed before sell, sell_all, buy, refuel, repair and place_orders. Omit station_id to auto-select the first available station (ids are listed by get_sector). Fails if the sector has no station. Changes ship status to DOCKED. Docking may cost a station fee in CWM (scales with ship tier, plus a toll in foreign corp sectors). Undock with undock; mine and warp undock a docked ship automatically.

bearer.description: Your SPACE-CORE Bearer token. Only needed if your client cannot send the Authorization header.

station_id.description: Station ID (from get_sector). Optional — auto-selects if omitted.

name: dock
title: Dock at station
